name: vivi
description: View large scientific images and stacks locally or over Remote SSH, with a configurable data explorer.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/explorerListing.js && node --check src/formats.js && node --check src/frameLabels.js && node --check src/backend.js && node --check media/viewer.js && node --check media/explorer.js

vivi.pythonPath.description: Python on the extension host. Empty uses the previous imageViewer.pythonPath setting, then python3.

vivi.defaultPath.description: Initial data explorer path on the extension host.

vivi.maxPreviewSize.description: Maximum transmitted preview dimension in pixels.

vivi.maxDecodedPixels.description: Guard for full-frame decoders (PNG/JPEG/video). FITS/TIFF use region access.

vivi.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Backend timeout. A timeout stops the worker; reopen the image to restart.

vivi.managedExtensions.description: File extensions opened by vivi on double-click. Remove one to use the editor default; video and other supported types can be added.

vivi.explorerContextMenu.description: Explorer context menu items, in display order. Remove entries to hide them.

vivi.preloadMaxMiB.description: Maximum raw preview cache size for stack preloading. When exceeded, vivi preloads nearby frames and keeps the previous frame visible while loading others.
